observations.1: 第1パス (Skill dev-graph:run-dev-graph-init --repo-root <fixture-repo> --hook-source plugin) が空 repo に対し 6 content root を作成: issues/ tasks/ specs/ architecture/ features/ docs/。routing policy は build-repo-config.py 経由で .dev-graph/config.json を created (digest sha256:b482d2a49b6c87dcde6394d443f258e8ecc7821fdcab35a2d4880c135b4bd706) として設置し、content_roots 7key + local_state + path_policy(stored_paths=repository-relative, allow_outside_repository=false) + claude_hooks(source=plugin) + github(enabled=false) を保持。graph store は build-graph-store.py が .dev-graph/state/graph.json を created (digest sha256:1c19617a3b9e1ec6cb8e372f6fe117be3a69de873c139bacf576dc4bc8fb0f57, graph_revision=0, 4-key envelope)。併せて .dev-graph/{cache,locks,templates} と template 21 件 (contract 列挙 16 + 同梱資産、missing_in_plugin=0) を scaffold。receipt: fixture-repo/eval-log/run-dev-graph-init-receipt-pass1.json
observations.2: 第2パスは同じ Skill リテラル呼び出しを再実行 (手書き存在チェックや script 直叩きでの代替なし)。planned_change_count=0 — 内訳: content_roots_created=0, local_state_dirs_created=0, templates_created=0, config_write=unchanged(changed=false, 同一 digest b482d2a4...), graph_store_write=preserved_existing(changed=false, graph_revision=1 のまま byte-preserve), settings_json_writes=0。第2パス前後で .git を除く全 36 ファイルの sha256 一覧が diff 完全一致 (TREE_IDENTICAL)。receipt: eval-log/run-dev-graph-init-receipt-pass2.json
observations.3: パス間に canonical template を 1 つだけ Edit: .dev-graph/templates/document.md の「## 関連資料」節へ LOCAL EDIT MARKER 行を追加。編集後 664 bytes / sha256 48986cdca0787b51248d362e9c28db1360eb839c5a5bc89afb7eae4295a4ed99 (全文は編集前後で保全コピーを保持)。第2パスの init を実際に走らせた後の同ファイルは 664 bytes / sha256 48986cdca0787b51248d362e9c28db1360eb839c5a5bc89afb7eae4295a4ed99 で前後一致、かつ編集前コピーとの diff も無差分。非上書きは file を眺めるだけでなく init 実行の出力自体が示す: 第2パス scaffold は created=0 / preserved_identical=20 / migration_preview=1 を返し、その 1 件が {template: document.md, reason: user_edited_not_overwritten, installed_sha256: 48986cdc...4ed99 (664B), plugin_sha256: 6c4311bad222591e47f7d279c8f533a8b8ab6e75fc4b10705b3447ea4186d59c (483B)}。plugin 側 template は無変更。
observations.4: hook source 解決は accepted (受理)。診断文そのまま: (a) "hook_source=plugin accepted: plugin manifest declares ./hooks/hooks.json and all 4 C10/C25 events (PostToolUse, PreToolUse, SessionStart, TaskCompleted) resolve to existing scripts under the resolved plugin_source; command strings reference only ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR}." (b) "no project fallback written: caller repo has no .claude/settings.json and no dev-graph hook registration, so effective wiring stays on the single plugin path (duplicate registrations=0, existing settings key/hash changes=0)." (c) advisory (拒否ではない): "dev-graph is not listed in the user's enabledPlugins, so a Claude session rooted at this caller repo would not load the plugin hooks until the plugin is installed/enabled or the operator re-runs init with --hook-source project-fallback (which requires the plain symlink .claude/dev-graph-plugin)." plugin_source=/Users/dm/orca/workspaces/HarnessHub/wt-27-2/plugins/dev-graph (C24 receipt 由来)、effective_hook_path_count=1、missing_hook_scripts=[]、caller_dev_graph_registrations=0。第1・第2パスとも同一結果で、fixture repo の .claude/settings.json は生成していない。
observations.5: validate-repo-config.py --require-content-roots issues tasks specifications architecture features documents が exit 0 / valid=true / violations=[] (schema・path containment・秘密材料の3層)。独立走査でも config の文字列値 56 件中、絶対パス 0 件 (先頭 '/' '~' ドライブレター)、host 固有パス 0 件 ('/Users/' '/home/' 'orca/workspaces' 部分一致)、token prefix (ghp_/gho_/ghu_/ghs_/ghr_/github_pat_) 0 件、GitHub node id prefix (PVT_/PVTI_/PVTF_/PVTSSF_/MDE/I_kw/PR_kw/U_kg) 0 件。stored_paths=repository-relative、github.enabled=false で owner/project number/field name のみ保持 (github セクションのキーは completion_policy/enabled/issue_repository/projects)。
observations.6: C11 (plugins/dev-graph/scripts/validate-graph-schema.py --repo-root <fixture-repo> --graph <fixture-repo>/.dev-graph/state/graph.json) が exit 0、valid=true、violations=[]、missing_sections=[]、implementation_readiness=complete。対象 store の node 件数は 1 件 (graph_node_id=doc-c01-idempotence-live-trial-seed、graph_revision=1)。この node はパス間に Skill dev-graph:run-dev-graph-node を呼び出し C02 単一 writer upsert-node.py で登録 (dry-run write_count=0 → apply: operation=added, status=applied, write_count=2, body_source=from_file, graph_revision 0→1)。gate 発火の確認として、同 store から必須キー implementation_readiness を 1 つ落とした negative control を C11 にかけると exit 1 / valid=false / violations=[{code: schema_violation, node: doc-c01-idempotence-live-trial-seed}] となり、空検査での exit 0 ではないことを実測済み。
